findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, source code, or Lambda console/API. This risks credential leakage and unauthorized AWS API access.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life/deprecated Node.js runtime no longer receiving security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
